summary: Frontend-only regression + feature test for MME site. Primary blank-page-on-first-SPA-navigation bug is FIXED: navigating from Home via the 'We Are' navbar dropdown to each of the 5 subpages (About Company, Board of Director, Our Team, Our Client, Annual Report) and cross-navigating between subpages (Annual Report -> Board) shows the destination testid container with computed opacity == '1' immediately, with no manual refresh. Also verified other top-level navbar links (Projects, Industries, Clients, Gallery, Careers, Contact, Services) and a service detail (/services/cement) render visible content on first SPA click. Annual Report shows 7 revenue bars ([data-testid=revenue-section] .group.flex-1 count == 7) and 7 table rows with correct years '2025 to 26' -> '2019 to 20' including '₹28,00,00,000/- (Projected)' and '₹1,23,45,014/-'. Board of Directors shows 2 cards with images loading successfully — /images/pradeep.png (874x976) and /images/vandana.png (417x571), correct names/roles (Pradeep Sharma – Director & CEO; Vandana Singh – General Manager - Human Resource) with multi-paragraph verbatim messages. Mobile (390px) hamburger opens, 'We Are' accordion expands, tapping Annual Report and Our Team both render content (opacity=1) and the revenue table container has overflow-x:auto with scrollWidth(440) > clientWidth(340) confirming horizontal scrollability.
critical_code_review_comments: useReveal.js fix is clean: depends on useLocation().pathname, uses rAF + 500ms fallback to reveal off-screen or in-view .reveal nodes after route change. Consider also observing DOM mutations if pages lazy-load extra .reveal nodes later (not currently the case).
Navbar 'We Are' parent Link (from prior iteration) still points to /we-are with no route — same non-blocking issue noted in iteration_1.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Blank-page bug is fixed via useReveal re-running on pathname change. All primary asserts covered: opacity==1 on destination testids after SPA link click (no reload), 7 revenue bars + 7 rows with expected years/amounts, both director images load (naturalWidth>0), mobile hamburger + We Are accordion works. Base URL from frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.
rca of the issue: N/A — reported bug already fixed; testing confirms fix works.
